title: My Favourite Subject
subtitle: 考点：学科 / 形容词 / because 说明理由
passage: I have many subjects this term. My favourite is geography. It is exciting because we learn about different countries and cities. History is useful because it tells us about the past, but some students think it is boring.
Biology is interesting. We study animals and plants. I am not good at math, but my teacher helps me with it. In the future, I want to be a scientist.
vocab: geography 地理 · history 历史 · biology 生物学 · boring 乏味的 · useful 有用的 · exciting 令人激动的 · past 过去 · good at 擅长 · scientist 科学家

questions.stem: What is the writer's favourite subject?
Why does the writer like it?
questions.why: It is exciting because we learn about different countries and cities.

questions.stem: What does history tell us about?
questions.why: it tells us about the past

questions.stem: What does the writer want to be in the future?
questions.why: In the future, I want to be a scientist.

sections.title: 二、判断正误（对选 T，错选 F）

All students think history is exciting.
